title: Earful case
description: An earful.case/1 document: everything about a scenario that is data. The agent and the model policy are code, named by `scenario`; the user's speeches, the provider delays the scenario declares, the settings, the seed and the contract policy are stated here, so a case can be moved in time, reduced and saved without touching code.

scenario.description: Where the scenario's code lives, as module:function. The function takes no arguments and returns the scenario with its default speeches and settings.

seed.description: Seed for every random choice in the run.

speeches.description: The scripted user's speeches, in order of their start.

start_us.description: True start, from the first audio frame.

transcript.description: What the recognizer delivers. Empty: noise.

stt_delay_us.description: From the end of the speech to its final transcript.

expects_reply.description: Whether the agent owes this turn a response. Null: yes, unless it is noise or a backchannel.

retires.description: Intents this turn corrects or cancels.

delays.description: Provider delays declared as data, each in place of what the scenario's code would ask for. At most one per delay and occurrence.

of.description: Which delay: the model's time to first token or its total generation time, the voice's time to first audio, or the time the backend takes to commit a write.

nth.description: Which occurrence, from 1: the model call, the synthesized utterance or the backend request.

settings.description: Timing and provider settings, by name. Which names exist is the adapter's business; every time is integer microseconds.

contracts.description: Contract id to the policy values declared for it.
